headlines.title: Kansas voters stress affordability as key issue in competitive Senate race
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is headed to Kansas in support of incumbent GOP Sen. Roger Marshall, who is in a tight race against his Democratic challenger, Adam Hamilton. NBC News' Stephanie Gosk spoke with voters who emphasized affordability as a key issue in the race.

headlines.title: Christina Applegate says she was misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis
headlines.description: Christina Applegate announced Tuesday that she had been misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis.

headlines.title: Russia Batters Ukraine Amid Trump-Zelenskyy Standoff
headlines.description: Russia launched new attacks across Ukraine as the increasingly bitter standoff between President Donald Trump and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy heats up. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Lawmaker reportedly loses leg as car ramming stuns Australia
headlines.description: An Australian lawmaker was in critical but stable condition Tuesday after being hit by a car in what authorities said was a deliberate attack, shocking a nation where political violence is extremely rare.

headlines.title: Trump pardons two vehicle repair shop owners during Alaska rally
headlines.description: During his rally in Alaska, President Trump pardoned Zachary Czuback and Patrick Fleming, co-owners of a vehicle repair shop in Anchorage. Both pleaded guilty in 2022 to violating the Clean Air Act by tampering with federally mandated and monitored devices that tracked vehicles’ diesel emissions.

headlines.title: Powerful nor’easter churning up the East Coast
headlines.description: A powerful nor’easter is churning up the East Coast and is on track to bring several days of heavy rain, flooding and strong winds.

headlines.title: Zelenskyy meets with Trump envoys as U.S. blasts ‘scandalous’ accusations on withdrawn support
headlines.description: U.S. envoys were expected to meet with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Norway on Tuesday, as Kyiv scrambles to respond to an American pressure campaign that has been allied with moves aimed at courting the Kremlin.
